# Dependency pins for TRACE v1.1.0
#
# Usage:
#   pip install -e . -c constraints.txt
#
# What this file is: a hand-maintained list of single versions for TRACE's
# direct dependencies, assembled from the development environment in which
# the manuscript benchmarks (Solanaceae GWAS, n=150-350) and the CI test
# runs were performed. pyproject.toml gives the supported version *ranges*;
# this file names one point inside those ranges.
#
# What it is not: it was not generated by `pip freeze`, and the pins were
# transcribed from that environment rather than captured at run time -- no
# lock file, freeze, or environment record accompanies the published runs.
# It covers direct dependencies only, not the full transitive closure, and
# it carries no hashes. Version pins alone do not reproduce a binary: the
# published runs used Windows CPython 3.11 wheels, while CI and the
# container install the Linux builds of the same versions.

# Numerical core
numpy==1.26.4
pandas==2.3.3
scipy==1.13.1
scikit-learn==1.7.2
statsmodels==0.14.5
numba==0.62.1

# GWAS-specific
fastlmm==0.6.12
# fastlmmclib is a transitive dependency of fastlmm (>=0.0.7). Pinning it here
# fixes the version without installing it, since a constraints file only
# constrains what something else pulls in. TRACE never calls the code path that
# loads it -- fastlmm imports it lazily inside its SNP-set / variance-component
# test, which TRACE does not use -- so this pin is build hygiene, not a
# numerical control. Unlike the pins above it was added on 2026-09-21, after
# the benchmark runs, rather than transcribed at authoring time: 0.0.7 is the
# version the development environment has carried continuously since
# 2026-02-23, spanning the whole benchmark window and the run in which the
# reported test count and coverage were measured, and 0.0.8 did not exist
# until 2026-08-07. Raising fastlmm to 0.6.13 would require fastlmmclib>=0.0.8,
# so the two lines move together.
fastlmmclib==0.0.7
pysnptools==0.5.14
scikit-allel==1.3.13
bed-reader==1.0.6

# Plotting
matplotlib==3.10.7
seaborn==0.13.2
plotly==6.3.1
kaleido==1.2.0

# Web / IO
streamlit==1.50.0
joblib==1.5.2
h5py==3.15.1
dask==2025.10.0
pyarrow==21.0.0
Jinja2==3.1.6
requests==2.32.5
PyYAML==6.0.3
tqdm==4.67.3
click==8.3.0
colorama==0.4.6
